St Johns Investment Management Company Cut Its Apple (AAPL) Stake by $415,233; Shares Declined; Boardwalk Pipeline Partners (BWP) Shareholder Tam Capital Management Has Upped Holding
May 1, 2018 - By Peter Erickson
Justin John Ferayorni increased its stake in Boardwalk Pipeline Partners (BWP) by 157.25% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Tam Capital Management Inc bought 1.04M shares as the company’s stock declined 27.31% with the market. The hedge fund run by Justin John Ferayorni held 1.70 million shares of the natural gas distribution company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $21.91M, up from 659,849 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Tam Capital Management Inc who had been investing in Boardwalk Pipeline Partners for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $2.77B market cap company. The stock decreased 2.81% or $0.32 during the last trading session, reaching $11.05. About 2.63 million shares traded or 106.50% up from the average. Boardwalk Pipeline Partners, LP (NYSE:BWP) has declined 42.11% since May 1, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 53.66% the S&P500.
St Johns Investment Management Company Llc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 9.5% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. St Johns Investment Management Company Llc sold 2,457 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 23,397 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $3.96 million, down from 25,854 at the end of the previous reported quarter. St Johns Investment Management Company Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $848.48B market cap company. The stock increased 1.19% or $1.96 during the last trading session, reaching $167.22. About 23.97 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 1, 2017 and is uptrending.
